name: Basic System Context
description: Create a simple C1 diagram showing a single system with users and external services
helpContent: Generate a C1 (System Context) diagram showing the primary system, its users/actors, and external dependencies. Use PlantUML C4 extensions for clean, professional architecture visualization.
template:
Create a C1 System Context diagram showing:
1. Main System: [System Name]
2. Users/Actors: [List key users/roles]
3. External Systems: [List integrations]

Include clear relationships between components.

name: Microservices System Context
description: C1 diagram for microservices architecture showing service boundaries and external integrations
helpContent: Create a high-level C1 diagram for microservices systems. Show the overall system boundary, key actors, and external systems. This provides context before diving into container or component details.
template:
Generate a C1 Context diagram for a microservices system with:
1. System Boundary: Microservices Platform
2. Internal Services: [List core services]
3. External Integrations: [APIs, databases, third-party services]
4. Users: [Admin users, end users, etc]

Focus on system-level interactions.

name: E-Commerce Platform Context
description: C1 diagram for e-commerce systems showing platform, users, and external services
helpContent: Design a C1 system context diagram for e-commerce platforms including payment gateways, inventory systems, customer databases, and various user roles.
template:
Create a C1 diagram for an e-commerce platform showing:
1. Platform: Online Store
2. Users: Customers, Admins, Support Staff
3. External Systems: Payment Gateway, Shipping API, Email Service, Analytics

Show all key interactions.
